caption: The drawing depicts a single kitchen tool, specifically a mezzaluna, centered on a plain, light beige background. The mezzaluna consists of a horizontal wooden handle, colored medium brown with visible wood grain details and a central seam. Attached to the handle is a double-pronged metal connector that curves downward and attaches to a wide, semi-circular blade. The blade is colored in a dark brown, textured to resemble aged or rusted metal, and features a slightly curved cutting edge. There are no additional objects or features in the drawing, and the only text visible is a small signature "N. Amantea" written in fine gray lettering toward the bottom left of the image.
title: Chopping Knife
